criteria.name: Design
criteria.covers: Roots, boundaries and data flows are explained; tradeoffs are recorded as ADRs.

criteria.name: Build
criteria.covers: Reusable modules; dev and prod differ only in values; no hand-made resources.

criteria.name: Secure
criteria.covers: Least privilege, no keys, guardrails, encryption, edge protection.

criteria.name: Automate
criteria.covers: Every root validated, planned and applied by CI, with reviews before prod.

criteria.name: Monitor
criteria.covers: Alerts reach humans with runbooks; logs are centralised and retained.

criteria.name: Scale
criteria.covers: Capacity survives a zone loss; data survives a region loss within objectives.

criteria.name: Document
criteria.covers: A newcomer can find why and how from the repository alone.

criteria.name: Test
criteria.covers: Modules have tests that would catch past mistakes; checks run before merge.

levels.2: Partly there: works, but with gaps a reviewer would flag
levels.3: Solid: meets the requirement with evidence
levels.4: Exemplary: goes beyond, and explains why
